findings.title: Continuous publication splits installed fixed groups
findings.description: enqueue/freeze ignore installed fixed group membership. discover exposes complete installed two-member group and continuous lane together. max_batch=1 publishes first member and marks accepted while second remains produced.
findings.expected: Reject fixed-group overlap at enqueue/freeze/publish including installation after enqueue; preserve complete group delivery.

findings.title: Post-check materialization conceals deleted history inputs
findings.description: Post-check prepare defaults materialize=True. Real check subprocess unlinks required history JSON; prepare recreates it and second batch is accepted. Both tasks became accepted.
findings.expected: Verify frozen history without materialization after execution and on replay/cache validation; reject deletion without silent rebuilding.
